                           'has been applied to proteomics previously but '
                           'can require increased sampling handling and '
                           'instrument time. Here we demonstrate an '
                           'automated online comprehensive '

                           'chromatography method for metaproteome sample '
                           'analysis. A high pH PLRP-S column was used in '
                           'the first dimension followed by low pH '
                           'separation in the second dimension using dual '

                           'method increased the number of unique peptides '
